stops.title: Wo Nhwɛbea
stops.caption: W’asɔre baa, ne deɛ ɛhia ɛnnɛ.
stops.speech: Wo nhwɛbea bue w’asɔre baa so: dodoɔ a wɔwɔ asafo no mu, ne deɛ ɛretwɛn wo sɛ wobɛyɛ ɛnnɛ.

stops.title: W’asɔre baa
stops.caption: Biribiara a ɛwɔ deɛ wodi anim no mu.
stops.speech: M’asɔre Baa ne deɛ wodi anim no nyinaa. Ne mufoɔ, n’akuo, n’ɔsom, ne wɔn a wɔaba foforɔ.

stops.title: Nhwɛmu no
stops.caption: Obiara, ne ne gyinabea.
stops.speech: Nhwɛmu no kyerɛ obiara a ɔwɔ w’asɔre baa mu. Nsensaneɛ no kyerɛ sɛ ɔyɛ ɔhɔhoɔ, ɔsanba, anaa wawie adesua no.

stops.title: Nkɔdi Akyi
stops.caption: Nhwɛmu mmiɛnsa, a berɛ nni mu.
stops.speech: Nkɔdi Akyi wɔ nhwɛmu mmiɛnsa: ahɔhoɔ foforɔ a obiara ne wɔn nkasaeɛ, wɔn a wɔnni kuo mu, ne nkitahodie a berɛ atwam.

stops.title: Nsɛm a Ɛha Adwene
stops.caption: Yiedie ne ahobammɔ, soronko.
stops.speech: Nsɛm a Ɛha Adwene kura yiedie ne ahobammɔ. Ɛyɛ nkrataa beaeɛ mmienu soronko, a nnipa a wɔnsɛ na wɔkenkan.

stops.title: Wo Fekuo
stops.caption: Kuo a wodi anim.
stops.speech: Fekuo a wodi anim no, wotumi kyerɛw mmaeɛ, kyerɛw nkɔdi akyi, na wohunu hwan na wagyae ba.

stops.title: W’adwumakuo
stops.caption: Mufoɔ, nnwuma nhyehyɛeɛ ne adwumayɛfoɔ pɛ.
stops.speech: W’adwumakuo mu no wohwɛ mufoɔ so, woyi nnwuma nhyehyɛeɛ adi, na wodi wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔka ho ho dwuma.

stops.title: Akra Kwan
stops.caption: Firi nkitahodie kɔsi adwumakuo mu.
stops.speech: Akra kwan di obi a yɛduruu ne ho wɔ asɛmpaka mu akyi, firi nkitahodie a ɛdi kan kɔsi adwumakuo mu kɔ.

stops.title: Amanneɛbɔ
stops.caption: W’asɔre baa, wɔ akontaa mu.
stops.speech: Amanneɛbɔ dane w’asɔre baa yɛ akontaa: mmaeɛ nkɔsoɔ, hwan na ɔnni hɔ, ne sɛdeɛ akuo no renyini.
